description: Trait de côte du versant littoral du Pays d’Auge 1955 (communes de Houlgate, Gonneville sur Mer, Auberville et Villers sur Mer) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Coastal section of the base of the slope determined by aerial photo of the 1955 IGN at the scale of the 1/25 000th georeferenced at the LETG Laboratory - Caen Géophen. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Coastal feature of the coastal slope of Pays d’Auge 1955 (communes of Houlgate, Gonneville sur Mer, Auberville and Ville" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include trait de côte, levé. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
